text:
alex thompson: Hey @marie (travel-ops) and @jamal, ran into a mess — had to change my award ticket last night to make a client meeting. Charged me a $450 change fee on my personal card. I can upload the receipt but need an emergency advance or fast reimbursement.
marie (travel-ops): thx for the heads up. Can you drop the booking link + the receipt image here? also confirm the meeting was client-facing and urgent.
alex thompson: booking: https://airline.example/booking/ABCD1234, receipt snip: `CHG FEE $450`, screenshot attached (will upload to Expensify). meeting was moved due to client outage — jamal was on the call with me.
jamal (manager): confirmed — client pushed the kickoff and we needed alex there same day. Approving the fee as business necessary. alex, I approve reimbursement; finance pls expedite. :white_check_mark:
finance-bot: Expense flagged: HIGH_AMOUNT. Please include manager approval and copy of call notes. Processing ETA: 5 business days unless advance required. /ticket# 7421.
shelly lee: Hi @alex — Finance here. We can either (A) fast-track reimbursement with manager approval + docs (usually 3-5 business days) or (B) issue a one-time payroll advance for the amount (processed in next payroll run, could be 7-10 days). Which do you prefer?
alex thompson: reimbursement is fine if it's 3 days. If not, I need the advance — short on funds until payday.
shelly lee: I triggered a priority reimbursement flow. Need two things from you to mark it priority: 1) upload receipt to Expensify under "urgent-travel-change-fee", 2) paste a short note of why change was necessary (can be 1 sentence).
alex thompson: done — uploaded, note: "Flight moved same-day for client outage and immediate kickoff; manager approved."
shelly lee: got both. Marking as PRIORITY. If the payout can't clear in 3 business days, we'll fall back to the payroll advance and let you know. :pray:
finance-bot: Reimbursement status updated to PRIORITY. Reference 7421-P. Expected bank settlement 3 business days.
alex thompson: amazing — thank you all. saved my weekend. :relieved:
